rangeMap.note: Adult male Grey Nightjar, cryptic dark grey heavily black-centred crown/mantle/scapular feathers and dark shoulder on folded wing. Male small white primary/tail corner patches are flight/spread traits not claimed demonstrated here. Longer tail/narrower wings than Savanna, primaries normally project beyond tail. Breeds Pakistan/Himalayas through China/SE Siberia/Korea/Japan, winters Indian subcontinent/SE Asia/Sumatra/Borneo/Philippines. HK locally common summer visitor to closed-canopy shrubland near streams/reservoirs. LC stable. World partial native-country overview only; green does not mean entire country occupancy, precise occurrence or complete range.
